name: superside-sales
description: Superside sales toolkit for BDR teams: cold-call (Jiminny), LinkedIn, and email (Gmail) syncs into a team's Notion Conversation Hub / All Accounts / All Meetings, plus rep-facing email + handover skills, a weekly run-all command, and a first-run team bootstrap. Multi-team: each team's databases are resolved live from the Sales page, so one install works for every team.

plugins.name: superside-sales-core
plugins.description: Team resolution, first-run Notion bootstrap, Salesforce priority-account import, and the /weekly-sync run-all command. Load this alongside the channel syncs.

plugins.name: convohub
plugins.description: Daily/7/30-day cold-call follow-up review from Jiminny, plus the meeting-emails, followup-email, and ae-handover-notes skills.

plugins.name: linkedin-crm-sync
plugins.description: Reads the rep's LinkedIn inbox and syncs matched conversations into the team's Conversation Hub / All Meetings.

plugins.name: email-crm-sync
plugins.description: Reads the rep's Gmail for external replies + genuine inbound and syncs eligible ones into the team's Conversation Hub / All Meetings.
